method: Khamis-Roche 1994 Pediatrics 94(4):504-507, erratum 1995 95(3):457 (erratum-corrected values as reported by secondary sources; primary PDF not accessed - paywalled)
metric: No published metric table found. Convert inputs (cm/2.54, kg/0.45359237), output *2.54. Do not ship a derived metric table as 'published'.
validity: Ages 4.0-17.5 y; healthy white (non-Hispanic) American children (Fels Longitudinal Study, 223 M / 210 F, SW Ohio); not for pathologic growth conditions.
error: Average 90% error bounds ~ +/-5.3 cm (2.1 in) boys, +/-4.3 cm (1.7 in) girls; 50% bounds ~ +/-2.2 cm boys, +/-1.7 cm girls (per InfantChart citing paper; uwmsk calculator also reports 50%/90% bounds). Age-specific bounds not obtained.
midparent_note: Sources implement midparent = simple mean of mother and father height (no sex adjustment, no +/-6.5 cm). Whether the paper requires adjusting self-reported parental heights was NOT verified (primary PDF not accessed).
